title: Worker platform: model config, extension allowlist, sandboxing, plan-mode safety
objective: Worker platform overhaul. (1) Worker model as first-class config: PI_WORKER_MODEL env wins, <agentDir>/worker-model.json next, NO hardcoded model anywhere — unconfigured delegate fails descriptively, 'main' inherits the session model; /worker-model picker + status-bar label mirroring small-model. (2) Worker extension allowlist: delegate param → PI_WORKER_EXTENSIONS env → config → defaults [messenger, code-search, context7, web-search, synthetic, neuralwatt, gondolin]; name→path resolution with validation; hard denylist (agents, missions, autoresearch, goal, plan). (3) Sandboxing: workers run under gondolin (--gondolin), headless-tolerant, fail fast without QEMU/Node>=23.6. (4) Plan-mode safety: delegate while planning forces read-only workers (--worker-readonly), plan extension gains headless read-only mode (tool gate only, no overlay), permission-bypass audit documented. Done: all implemented, READMEs updated, E2E drill passes, full check green.
